🎥🎬: Jeffrey (1995)

Jeffrey is a gay New York actor and waiter who becomes increasingly frightened by the AIDS epidemic and the risks associated with intimacy. Convinced that avoiding sex is the only way to protect himself from heartbreak and illness, he makes an unusual decision to become completely celibate. However, his plans are challenged when he meets Steve Howard, a charming man who seems to be everything he has ever wanted.

Just as Jeffrey begins falling for Steve, he discovers that Steve is HIV-positive. Terrified of losing someone he could grow to love, Jeffrey struggles with whether he should walk away or take a chance on a relationship that could expose him to emotional pain. Seeking guidance from his closest friends, including Sterling, played by Sir Patrick Stewart, Jeffrey is forced to confront his fears about love, commitment, and mortality.

source_details.synopsis: Jeffrey is a 1995 American romantic comedy film directed by Christopher Ashley, based on the play of the same name by Paul Rudnick, who also wrote the screenplay adaptation. The film stars Steven Weber, Michael T. Weiss, Patrick Stewart, and Bryan Batt.
